coverage: Capture and restore two native Durable Objects plus shared R2 through signed namespace archives and a durable journal.
Application/LFS and authorization/registry state compares equal after restored object eviction.
Restored pack/index and raw loose R2 objects stream to temporary files; Git independently hashes loose objects.
Git verify-pack, strict full fsck, refs/HEAD, shallow-state and exact object-byte comparisons pass.
Stock Git clones the reconstructed recovered repository and fsck passes on the clone.
Both targets stay fenced through verification; explicit release binds the verification-report digest and preserves source fences.
Existing native fault/resume tests pass after shared runtime extraction.
limits: Small native local fixture with a shallow root commit, one pack/index pair and a retained loose empty tree.
The stock-Git clone reads a reconstructed filesystem repository, not the deployed Cloudflare HTTP host.
No complete hub/fork behavioral recovery, production-scale qualification or installation-wide isolation proof.
Cloudflare account deployment and production recovery targets remain open.
